features: Face comparison: up to 30,000 face images in 20 face databases
Driver status monitoring (DSM): smoking, calling, yawning, looking around unfocused, being absent
ADAS: warning of cars hit, lane departure detection
Licence plate and vehicle brand recognition
Up to 2 intelligent rules active at the same time
Vehicle event detection: rollover and collision
SD card slot, up to 512 GB
2 RS-232 ports, 1 RS-485 port, 1 CAN port
Remote monitoring: web viewer, KBiVMS and KBView Plus
notes: Mobile recorder. The 4 IP inputs are PoE RJ-45 ports; the 2 HDCVI inputs are used for DSM/ADAS cameras.
Product page summary states 4 MP real-time recording, while the specification table gives 1080P recording for all channels. Maximum camera resolution left out.
Power consumption is stated as 12 W or less, for the recorder alone without any peripheral.
Alarm inputs: alarms 1 to 8 are local inputs and alarm 9 is a pulse input. Alarm outputs: 1 relay output and 1 controllable 12 V 0.75 A output.
Only a gross weight with packaging (2.1 kg) is published; weight left out.
